title: Potential SQL injection via query concatenation
guidance: Use a constant SQL template with PreparedStatement and bind untrusted values.

title: Potential SQL injection in a SQLite query
guidance: Use a constant SQL template with ? placeholders and pass the values separately to execute().

title: Potential SQL injection in a Node.js SQLite query
guidance: Prepare a constant SQL template with ? placeholders and bind values separately to the statement.
